Commentary.Commentary: After a roller coaster encounter at Eden Park, we now head to Napier for the second bout of the 3-match ODI series. The last game in Auckland bragged all the headlines as we witnessed one of the best performances in ODIs by Marcus Stoinis. He caught the world by surprise as he smacked an unbeaten 146 runs after the visitors were seen struggling at 67 for 6 and almost took his team home. He also became the first Australian to score a century and pick up a 3-wicket haul in the same ODI. Unfortunately he could not win the match, but would take heart from his all-round performance and hope to stay consistent. The batting struggled in the last game but the management will hope the ones given a chance to resurrect their ODI career get their mojo back. The lower order contributed for them but Australia will want more from the top order. They will hope to bounce back and make it even. Matthew Wade is racing against time to get fit as he awaits his debut as a captain. Williamson on the other hand, will want to seal the deal as he will try to seek revenge of their recent whitewash Down Under. He will wish that his bowlers stay consistent with the ball and close the game out unlike their last encounter, where they nearly lost the game. They will be unhappy on losing Martin Guptill due to a recurring hamstring issue as he was looking threatening in the first game. Another collective performance with the bat is what the Kiwis would be banking upon. So will the hosts seal the series or will the Aussies level it with a win?
